about:
Wood Products Northwest Inc. operates from Ellensburg, Washington, where it was founded in 1989. The company began when its CEO identified a gap between industry needs and the limited supply of custom cabinet manufacturers in the region.

The shop produces custom cabinetry for residential kitchens, bathrooms, and offices, as well as commercial casework and countertops. Its capabilities span custom cabinetry, commercial casework, and countertop fabrication, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

The company serves both residential and commercial construction markets, supplying cabinets and casework for remodel and new-build projects. Its supply chain includes partnerships with major hardware and surface brands such as Blum, Formica, Wilsonart, and Sherwin-Williams, among others.

Wood Products Northwest emphasizes professional, personalized, and fast service, backed by top-of-the-line materials, current production technologies, and a qualified team, aiming to become a long-term preferred partner for its customers.
